Discussion

DDA is a growing societal problem with emerging adults commonly utilizing technology as a mechanism for perpetrating aggressions against a current or former intimate partner. The importance of factors from the TPB was partially supported by attitudes, perceived norms, and perceived control accounting for 34% to 44% of the variance in intentions to perpetrate three forms of DDA. Specifically, attitudes emerged as the strongest predictor of intentions for all three DDA types, followed by subjective norms. Perceived behavioral control failed to predict intentions for any of the DDA behaviors.
